executeList.name: ensure-oid-working-online
executeList.sourceFile: LOOP=1 ; while [ $LOOP != 0 ]; do timeout 1 bash -c 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/obpceng9oid.wpdev.mintpress.io/18001' ; LOOP=$? ; echo 'contacting obpceng9oid.wpdev.mintpress.io18001' ; sleep 1 ;  done ;  /bin/true
